text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin Ooooooo!! Happy birthday, ma'am! 
I love you soooo muuuuuch!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you sooo much!! I love you too, 
Bamboo-san! I love, love, LOVE YOUUUU!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaah! Th-That was amazing! Your 
momentum is out of this world!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Um... you two are both... really full of 
energy, aren't you...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Heh, I am merely returning love with love.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Birthday celebrations are truly delightful 
after all. If you receive, you return! If 
you're happy, you return even more! It's 
the flawless logic of an honor student!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No matter how loud I shout, she always 
shouts back... It's so frustrating! I 
don't wanna lose in spirit! I wanna win!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's basically turned into a 
full-on showdown now. ...Still, I get how 
you feel.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Having people who celebrate your birthday. 
Having people who smile for you. —It makes 
you want to return all that warmth, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“—I'd like to celebrate you, too. Bakushin 
O, would that be alright?”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! Go right ahead! Now, 
let's wrap the world in love with full 
force!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O, happy birthday. Having you 
around brightens my heart. ...Thank you 
for being born.
